card.name: Start of computer size numbers
card.fires_on: The first digit (or the space before it) of a size or address number in computing text, such as 2 in 2 terabytes, 2^32, or 1024 in file listings.

modes.label: Capacity and address limits
modes.description: Leading digit of a storage or addressing limit in prose about SD cards, FAT32 or databases.

modes.label: File sizes in listings
modes.description: The number or the space before it in Unix directory or disk partition listings.

card.plain: It fires on the first digit of a technical size number, like a storage limit or file size in a directory listing.
